name: 24357-longprefill-gemma3n-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- the model fits one card.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request exactly 8192 prompt tokens and exactly 150 output tokens, sent as a plain completion (`request_format: plain`, no chat template) at `temperature: 0.0`, prefix caching off and prompts independently random.
purpose: A long-document analysis service summarizing eight-thousand-token reports into short briefs for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3n-E2B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 32768
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "PIECEWISE"}
